_doc: Pre-GRPO costs for the pipeline comparison on compare.html (SFT + vanilla GRPO vs Q-function + aux GRPO). The Q-function run is the SFT run: next-token cross-entropy on GPT-5.6 Luna's passing trajectories, LoRA r=64 on the same modules as the GRPO policy (aees/reward/PLAN.md R2-R10). Sources per field.
_sft_epochs_src: post_training/configs/sft.sh --num-epoch 2 and reward PLAN.md R10; qfunc_1030_1950 ran 1 (budget), so SFT cost = 2 × its measured epoch

sft._src: reward/runs/qfunc_1030_1950: data_manifest.json (train split), metrics.jsonl (per-step seconds, tokens, targets, mfu). node_hours: node up 11:38 PT (state/nebius.env written) to deleted 14:09 PT (nebius.env.deleted-1030_1409), 2026-10-30; covers setup, preflight T0-T6, training, eval, backup.

beta_pass._src: aq_check.sh (base policy + Q adapter, two forward passes) on the vanilla run's step-1 trajectories; reward/runs/aq_check/report.json; node lifetime from post_training/state/budget_ledger.json.

grpo._src: scripts/budget_guard.py list prices: H200 $5.40/GPU-h, m7a.8xlarge $1.85/h. Colocated: rollout and training run one after the other on the same H200, the boxes bill throughout.
